title: Flasqueness of the product of module stalk skyscrapers
statement: For every scheme $X$ and module sheaf $F$, the abelian sheaf underlying $T(F)=\prod_{x\in X} i_{x,*}F_x$ is flasque, including for empty schemes and zero sheaves.

source.place: Godement resolution; Lemma 20.30.1 (0FKS); monad multiplication and tensor compatibility: Banerjee, arXiv:1004.1491, section 1.1.4, pp. 15--16.

proof.text: Evaluation of module sheaves on an open preserves products. The product comparison and Types.productIso identify sections with families of skyscraper sections. The projection compatibility identifies restriction with coordinatewise restriction. Extend a family on a smaller open by zero at each point outside it, and transport it back through the product comparison. This explicitly lifts any section, so the underlying abelian restriction is surjective and hence epi.
